meaning.en: the first meal of the day

example.en: I have eggs for breakfast every morning.
example.tr: Her sabah kahvaltıda yumurta yerim.

meaning.en: a person who lives near you

example.en: Our neighbor has a friendly dog.
example.tr: Komşumuzun cana yakın bir köpeği var.

meaning.en: having a lot of things to do

example.en: I can't talk now, I'm busy.
example.tr: Şu an konuşamam, meşgulüm.

meaning.en: Saturday and Sunday

example.en: We usually visit my grandparents at the weekend.
example.tr: Hafta sonu genellikle büyükannemle büyükbabamı ziyaret ederiz.

meaning.en: not costing much money

example.en: This bag was very cheap.
example.tr: Bu çanta çok ucuzdu.

meaning.en: needing rest or sleep

example.en: She is always tired after a long day at work.
example.tr: Uzun bir iş gününden sonra hep yorgun olur.

meaning.en: to take something and give it back later

example.en: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
example.tr: Kalemini bir dakikalığına ödünç alabilir miyim?

meaning.en: a trip from one place to another

example.en: The journey to Ankara took six hours.
example.tr: Ankara'ya yolculuk altı saat sürdü.

meaning.en: to ask someone to come to an event

example.en: They invited us to their wedding.
example.tr: Bizi düğünlerine davet ettiler.

meaning.en: a substance you take to treat an illness

example.en: Take this medicine twice a day.
example.tr: Bu ilacı günde iki kez al.

meaning.en: to not remember something

example.en: Don't forget to call your mother.
example.tr: Anneni aramayı unutma.

meaning.en: making a lot of loud sound

example.en: The street outside my window is very noisy.
example.tr: Penceremin önündeki sokak çok gürültülü.

meaning.en: able to recover quickly from difficulties

example.en: Children are often more resilient than adults think.
example.tr: Çocuklar çoğu zaman yetişkinlerin sandığından daha dayanıklıdır.

meaning.en: to succeed in doing something after effort

example.en: She achieved her goal of running a marathon.
example.tr: Maraton koşma hedefine ulaştı.

meaning.en: able to be trusted to do what is expected

example.en: I need a reliable car for long trips.
example.tr: Uzun yolculuklar için güvenilir bir arabaya ihtiyacım var.

meaning.en: a chance to do something

example.en: This job is a great opportunity to learn.
example.tr: Bu iş, öğrenmek için harika bir fırsat.

meaning.en: to stay away from something

example.en: Try to avoid eating late at night.
example.tr: Gece geç saatte yemek yemekten kaçınmaya çalış.

meaning.en: to make or become better

example.en: Reading every day will improve your vocabulary.
example.tr: Her gün okumak kelime dağarcığını geliştirir.

meaning.en: not willing to do something

example.en: He was reluctant to admit his mistake.
example.tr: Hatasını kabul etmeye gönülsüzdü.

meaning.en: complete and careful about every detail

example.en: The doctor gave me a thorough examination.
example.tr: Doktor beni kapsamlı bir şekilde muayene etti.

meaning.en: the result of an action or process

example.en: Nobody can predict the outcome of the match.
example.tr: Maçın sonucunu kimse tahmin edemez.

meaning.en: so great that it is hard to deal with

example.en: The amount of work felt overwhelming at first.
example.tr: İşin miktarı ilk başta bunaltıcı geldi.

meaning.en: to believe something is true without proof

example.en: Don't assume that everyone agrees with you.
example.tr: Herkesin seninle aynı fikirde olduğunu varsayma.

meaning.en: always behaving or happening in the same way

example.en: Consistent practice is the key to learning a language.
example.tr: İstikrarlı pratik, dil öğrenmenin anahtarıdır.

meaning.en: showing great attention to detail

example.en: She keeps meticulous records of her expenses.
example.tr: Harcamalarının son derece titiz bir kaydını tutar.

meaning.en: seeming to be everywhere at the same time

example.en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
example.tr: Akıllı telefonlar modern hayatta her yerde karşımıza çıkar oldu.

meaning.en: having more than one possible meaning

example.en: The instructions were ambiguous, so we asked for help.
example.tr: Talimatlar belirsizdi, bu yüzden yardım istedik.

meaning.en: to examine something very carefully

example.en: The committee will scrutinize every application.
example.tr: Komite her başvuruyu dikkatle inceleyecek.

meaning.en: certain to happen and impossible to avoid

example.en: Some mistakes are inevitable when you learn something new.
example.tr: Yeni bir şey öğrenirken bazı hatalar kaçınılmazdır.

meaning.en: able to express ideas clearly and persuasively

example.en: She gave an eloquent speech at the ceremony.
example.tr: Törende etkili ve akıcı bir konuşma yaptı.
